blocks.text: MALAYBALAY CITY, Bukidnon — More than a showcase of picturesque landscapes and eco-adventure spots, Malaybalay City’s local tourism narrative is delving into its cultural roots and artistic soul. The city government of Malaybalay opened City Tourism Week 2026 on Monday, transforming the city hall lobby in Barangay Casisang into a convergence point for local heritage, sustainable tourism, and indigenous expression. Anchored on the theme “Discover to Love More Malaybalay,” the month-long observance centers on SAKA, the city’s core tourism framework representing sports, agri-ecotourism, kultura (culture), and adventure.
